answer_1.quote: Visual spatial description is a newly emerged vision-language task, which aims to generate a textual descriptive sentence of the spatial relationship between two target visual objects in a given image.
answer_1.outputs: Textual descriptive sentences of spatial relationships between two target objects in an image

answer_2.quote: Following , we adopt five automatic metrics to evaluate performances, including BLEU-4, MENTEOR, ROUGE, CIDEr and SPICE.

answer_4.quote: We also provide a human evaluation to describe spatial diversity with respect to the Spatial Accuracy, Spatial Diversity and Fluency. We ask 10 English speakers to answer the 5-point Likert scale on 100 samples...
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators used a 5-point Likert scale to rate generated descriptions on Spatial Accuracy, Spatial Diversity, and Fluency.
